alt: 學生看到同學對自己微笑後臉紅出神，手中書本拿反，幾張紙悄悄滑落。
scene_prompt: 神魂顛倒 means someone is mentally dazed and emotionally confused, often because they are lovestruck. In a modern school hallway, a teenage student notices a classmate smiling from across the hall and becomes flustered and distracted, holding a workbook upside down while a few loose papers slip gently from their arms. Soft dreamy curved pencil lines and faint watercolor swirls around the student's head suggest a heart-muddled daydream, without text or literal hearts. The classmate smiles politely and continues walking; innocent and age-appropriate. Natural anatomy with exactly two arms and legs, hands hold book plausibly, papers fall toward ground, school environment perspective sensible.
